# ErrorLens

> ErrorLens is open-source error tracking, performance monitoring (APM), log management, and cron and uptime monitoring. It runs as one container plus Postgres (self-hosted, free, AGPL-3.0) or as a hosted service at errorlens.io with a free plan of 5,000 error events a month. Secrets are scrubbed before anything is stored.

Key facts:
- SDKs (MIT, zero dependencies): Python `pip install errorlens`; Node.js `npm install @errorlenshq/node`; browser `npm install @errorlenshq/browser`.
- Python integrations: Django, Flask, FastAPI, Starlette, Celery, SQLAlchemy, httpx, logging.
- Node.js: any http server, Express, Fastify, Koa, Hapi, serverless; browser: any framework, React, Next.js.
- OpenTelemetry: OTLP/HTTP traces (/v1/traces) and logs (/v1/logs), protobuf or JSON.
- Other languages: any SDK that speaks the standard error-envelope protocol works with an ErrorLens DSN.
- Source: https://github.com/errorlenshq
